sample.q: Love the club really do hitting it very well. Knock on wood lol a friend has tried it he likes it yo talk of himself getting one
I’m not the golfer but he is and he loves lucky irons very happy with all he has

sample.t: So nice, I bought it twice!
sample.q:
I bought myself a 60 degree last year. I love it so much, and get so many comments/compliments on the look… but the performance speaks even louder!
In this recent purchase I bought 2 more and gave them to my dad for Father’s Day and my brother for his birthday (same week!).
They love them!

The club itself, outstanding. Looks sharp, plays well, nice feel. Definitely a good addition to the bag.
First club got lost in transit. Took forever to get a response from anyone. Like weeks. Actually got a notification of a replacement shipping before anyone actually replied to me. 
So, as long as it ships ok, you’ll love the club! But good luck if there’s an issue. Hope you have patience.
Super great club, love the feel, the sound, the spin, only problem I have is getting under the ball with it but easy fix none the less. Great club!!
Very good club. Performs as well as my Vokey SM10, and Cleveland RTX wedges. Consistent distances and puts good spin on the ball. All around solid performer.
Took one swing and the head separated from the shaft right where the ferrule is. Pretty disappointed. I hate going through the hassle of returning things so i guess im just out a hundred bucks :/
They’re fucking awesome. Yall are killing it
I LOVE my wedges they preform high up with the big name brands and all my friends are jealous of how sexy these clubs are
Love the weight of this club! Great looking bag candy! It’s so pretty I’m almost afraid to use it. I like it more than my titleist vokey

This is a sweet looking club! 
Just a bit to long for me, but it should be an easy fix. Shipping was fast!
One of the absolute best purchases I ever made. all of my friends are jealous from the look.And when they stick on the green and come back two feet, there's no doubt their top quality
Great quality! Made a perfect gift for my fianće!

Took a chance on these wedges and have been very pleasantly surprised at their appearance, performance and durability. Would definitely recommend for someone looking for a solid wedge and doesn’t want to pay the price for the large and popular brands and doesn’t have the need or want to get fitted!
I've only played twice with it love it so far, still have to dial in the distance
Loving the wedges so far have seen improvement in my game since using them!
My buddies already named my club “Goldy” because they are jealous of the results!!

I’ve got a few hours of range time and 2, 18-hole rounds with the 54° and 60° clubs. They look good enough to make me feel good and play well with them. They make me want to play more. The fit and finish are great. I like the green grip. Clubs feel solid.
The new Lucky wedges look and feel great and strike pure! I always play better when I feel Lucky!
This club was a Valentine’s Day gift for my husband, and he loves it. He says he loves how it feels and the unique gold design looks so cool.
Played for about 3 weeks been good so far

Gotta admit, I didn't have a 60 degree wedge so I bought this one because it's GOLD. Love the look. Liked it so much I also bought the 52 degree and the Hybrid. If you play Hybrid's this one is the real deal! Liked these so much I ordered a putter that's supposed to be here Friday. I'll write a review after a few rounds with it. Thanks Lucky Golf...I love my clubs!
I have the 60 deg and the club surprised me right out of the box. I thought is was going to be all sizzle but that’s not the case. One of the better 60 s I’ve used.
Love it. Played with both the 58 and the 54 I bought before and I love the feel and bite they both have.
HE hasnt used it on the course yet, but the quality is great!

I ordered a Christmas present for my boyfriend, it got lost in the mail. Cole personally texted me to get the correct information, and sent a new one that arrived a few days later. I highly recommend!!

The putter and wedge are amazing, but what truly impresses me is the exceptional customer service. They responded to my email on a Sunday and even followed up with a phone call, which was answered by a person on a Sunday! I was shocked, but they explained that their goal is to make every purchase perfect, one happy customer at a time. It really blew me away.
People borrow it in my league- it’s a winner!
My husband has been extremely happy with his Golf Club, excellent quality and pretty to look at.
I love Lucky Golf! I love the 60 degree and the 54!
I purchased the 52 degree wedge and I replaced it with my 54 degree wedge i like this 52 degree wedge much better from 69 yards to around the greens.
Very nice looking wedge. Good grips, but have not tried on the course yet
This was for my wife. She used it few times so far and liked it. Its heavier than most wedges as checked against mine. So far no concerns with it.

This is a gift for Christmas.
My only complaint is that the return policy is prior to when I give the gift.
Love it club face grooves seem to give me way more control!! 4.5 stars
Love the look and the feel of the clubs. Just wish the shaft was a little stiffer. I am sure I will get use to it.
Ordered the 56 degree wedge as I really wanted to try these clubs out. 1st day on the course the clubhead broke. Hoping it was just a fluke situation
I had these for a little over a month. Shaft has already dent in it already and showing signs of rust of 6 rounds of golf

Haven%27t%20played%20them%20yet%20since%20it%27s%20December%20in%20Wisonsin,%20but%20they%20look%20nice.

I like the 60 around the greens. It performs as good as my past Vokey, JAWS etc. However, the shaft on it is not the same quality so for full shots or 3/4 shots I don't have as much trust in it. I also get a bunch of compliments on it's looks. Cool club for sure!
The way these clubs look in my bag gets me loads of compliments. BUT the metal is soft, I don’t hit the ball hard and I’ve already have some bumps in the milling
Solid club. Looks great. Everyone asks about it. -1 star for lacking a little feel. -1 star for being back ordered for half the summer

The wedge was delivered today and it's a 58 instead of the 60 degree I ordered. Please advise on what can be done to rectify this mishap. This is my first purchase with your company and I'm disappointed with my experience.
The shaft is already bent and I’m extremely upset about it.
Can’t seem to get a consistent hit with it
I have only played one round and distance felt more like a lob wedge and not 50 degree.
Not only do the start the conversation but they are my favorite clubs to hit!

Every shot I touch now turns to gold since I got this lucky golf wedge. Pure beauty in each stroke, it's total head turner. You don't even have to take it out of the bag and people ask you about it. Solid gold baby!
Lucky Golf LGW02 Gold
Awesome wedge and fast shipping!

Bought the mallet putter and 56° wedge, do not regret at all. I was previously using a second hand putter and the difference is night and day, anything within 10 ft feels makable. They are not kidding when they say these clubs are lucky, second round taking them out on the first hole I completely bladed the wedge and the ball went flying right at the hole and dunked in without hitting green at all. I've never chipped in off the green this is a first and I'm a 25 handicap so I need all the luck I can get!
Ellecent
This club has been working wonders for me. I feel like I have full control of the ball with spin and trajectory. Cant wait to try more clubs from here!!

Love club
I was promised a free glove
Never arrived

Looks great got it for a present for my nephew he loves it
Great time of arrival and the club looks great!
It came on time
Liked the 50 so much I went back and picked up a 56..can't go wrong with these.
Great looking club and feels great , I bought the LGW02. I hope they start making more options for the LGW02 I bought the 56 and 60

sample.t: Just what I needed in my bag
sample.q: I ordered the 60 and 52! They have a great feel to them. Not only do they look nice they feel nice! Good weight, good control!
Lucky Golf LGW02 Gold

I purchased the LGW02 Gold and I have used it several times already and it is a solid club. I am getting great backspin and when I need the ball to check it's doing that as well. I get comments on the club at every course I play. I have two Lucky wedges a 52 and a 56 and my biggest problem is I grab the wrong one because they are both gold. But that's on me because I purchased both in gold because they are so sharp.

5 stars

Started playing lucky wedges almost two years ago and never looked back.
One of the best clubs in my bag by far!!! Lots of spin and very consistent to hit.
Try it ,,,,, hands down the best wedge on the market today.
I bought a putter last year and loved it! Decided to buy a wedge. Haven't used it yet but looking forward to trying it out!
Lucky Golf LGW02 Gold
This was a gift for my son for Christmas. He absolutely loves it.

These wedges are great. I did have one issue with my 60 degree wedge but was able to contact customer service. They ended up giving me a coupon code for a new wedge and also told me I could keep the existing one. Solid company and great clubs!
Great looks and performance for the price
Lucky Golf LGW02 Gold
Just bought the Lucky LGW02 Gold 52* wedge and on my first 50 yard shot dropped it 3 feet from the pin!!
